Hotel management system (PMS) for larger hotels and chains

Rooms, bookings, payments and housekeeping in one system for a larger hotel or a chain, with guest data ready for E-mehmon and channels connected through a certified channel manager. An MVP in 8–12 weeks, from UZS 144 mln; the full version in 16–28 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Room inventory and calendar
  • Bookings from the front desk and the website
  • Check-in and check-out
  • Payments and invoices
  • Guest data ready for E-mehmon registration
  • Housekeeping statuses
What the full version adds
  • Connection to a certified channel manager (Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia)
  • Dynamic rates
  • Restaurant and minibar charges to the room
  • Telegram concierge for guests
  • Owner reports
  • Several properties
Please note

Two-way sync with Booking.com, Expedia and Airbnb runs through a certified channel manager; we connect it and do not build our own. For a single hotel under about 50 rooms start with ind-hotel-kit. Direct E-mehmon integration depends on the access the system grants; otherwise we prepare the data for quick manual entry.

What we need from you

  • How the work runs today and sample documents
  • Existing data: Excel or an old system
  • Staff to try the system
  • One person who makes the decisions

Questions
